gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the 15-inch MacBook Air can run no more than two external displays over its own DisplayPort-over-USB-C (Apple: M4, 2025) and only one on the M2 (2023). So a 15-inch-class extender with three added 1920×1200 panels cannot light all three natively on that laptop. The third screen, and on an M2 every screen after the first, has to come through a USB display driver.
standout_why: I compared against UPERFECT's '8 Best Triple Screen Laptop Extenders in 2026' (cited in the second chat), which says only that 'base MacBook M1 and M2 chip models only support one external display'. It does not mention DisplayPort Alt Mode, DisplayLink or the M4 two-display limit, and it does not tie the count of added screens to a driver. Our own cited 16-inch page states the driver-free rule (each screen needs its own video path) and the base M1/M2 limit, but only for 16-inch MacBook Pros. I could not open the Newegg Hyangin Z3 listing (HTTP 403) or FOPO's S788 page (the store returned HTTP 429 all session), so I could not check what they say. So rivals cover part of the mechanism (the base M1/M2 limit) but not the 15-inch MacBook Air numbers that apply here.
decides: This confirms the split ChatGPT's second answer hinted at without a source. Three added screens on a 15-inch laptop means a driver-based extender. Two added screens can run driver-free only if the laptop has two video paths: a 15-inch MacBook Air M4 has two video-capable Thunderbolt 4 ports, while a 15-inch MacBook Air M2 drives one external display only. The question's 15-inch, 1920×1200 limit leaves FOPO S980 (15.3-inch, partner store, no record yet) and Hyangin Z3 (15.6-inch) as the only true 15-inch-class triples, and both have three added screens. I could not source the video path of either one today. None of the screens we link is a 15-inch 1920×1200 model: the S788, S11 and S9G are 16-inch and the S7 is 14-inch. Whether two of our rows fit the question therefore depends on reading '15 inch' as the laptop size (the S788 states a 12–18.5-inch fit range, FOPO's range). Otherwise the page should skip.
